details: For finite concept classes. A reverse linear bound is already known: $\mathrm{dens}^p\le2\mathrm{VC}\le2\mathrm d_{\min}^p$ (relationships 62 and 78). Consequently this strict witness cannot be upgraded to an unbounded ratio.
name: Projected Double Density or Projected Average Degree / Projected Minimum Degree
proof: For every projection, average degree is at least minimum degree.  Taking maxima over projections preserves the inequality.
